title: Glutathione vs Alpha Arbutin: Which Is Right for Your Skin?
ex: Glutathione is for an all-over radiant look; alpha arbutin focuses on dark spots. See how they differ, who each suits, and how to use them together.
rt: Glutathione vs Alpha Arbutin: Which Suits You? | Mirc Glow
rd: Glutathione vs alpha arbutin: a simple comparison table, which suits dull skin or dark spots, and how to use both together in one easy night routine.
quick: Glutathione is an antioxidant for an all-over radiant, fresher look, while alpha arbutin is spot-focused and helps dark marks and patches look less noticeable. They do different jobs and work well together, either in one cream or one routine, with sunscreen every morning.
facts: Glutathione is an antioxidant made naturally in the body.
Alpha arbutin slows tyrosinase, an enzyme involved in making pigment.
Both usually need 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen for a more even look.
Mirc Glow Glass Glow Cream contains both, plus niacinamide, hyaluronic acid and centella.
